results.excerpt:
Use **Download** on a completed backup, or `impreza_download_backup` with
`backup_id`. REST: `POST /v1/backups/{id}/download-link`.
The response provides presigned URLs for the manifest and chunks in your own
storage bucket, expiring after five minutes. Download every part required by
the manifest. These URLs grant access to backup contents until expiry: do not
commit them, put them in tickets or share them with untrusted recipients.
Bucket credentials are not returned and backup bytes do not pass through the
portal. Incomplete backups and unreadable manifests cannot be downloaded by
this workflow; ownership and manifest-size/part limits are enforced.
